title: HumanAwareLiftAI: synthetic lift-dispatch experiments and passenger-event records
description: Code and synthetic simulation data for a study of explicit occupancy and priority rules in multi-lift dispatch. Includes a corrected 16,848-run matched-arrival campaign (108 scenarios, thirteen configurations, 22,998,183 passenger records) with component ablation, door and transfer delays, dispatch-bonus and restricted-horizon sensitivity; a historical 279,936-run factorial campaign; and a superseded 5,184-run legacy event-recording campaign with 7,076,364 passenger records and a replay-parity analysis. Provides restricted-wait outcomes, paired scenario intervals, checksums and reproduction scripts. Code is MIT-licensed and data are CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSING.md). Synthetic simulation only; no physical sensing, interface validation or human-participant data.
